record.original_question: If G is a planar graph of maximum degree Delta(G), must the chromatic number of its square satisfy chi(G^2) <= floor(3 Delta(G) / 2) + 1 whenever Delta(G) > 8, together with the sharp small-degree cases stated by Wegner's planar graph conjecture?

evidence.quote: Wegner’s Planar Graph Conjecture ([183]). If G is planar with maximum degree ∆, then χ2(G) 6 7 if ∆ = 3, ∆ + 5 if 4 6 ∆ 6 7, and floor(3∆/2) + 1 if ∆ > 8.

Every planar graph G with maximum degree ∆(G) > 8 satisfies χ2(G) 6 floor(3∆/2) + 1. This is Wegner’s Planar Graph Conjecture (which also conjecture sharp bounds on χ2(G) for planar graphs with smaller maximum degree). This conjecture is known to hold asymptotically, even for list coloring (see Theorem 6): For each ǫ > 0 there exists ∆ǫ such that if G is a planar graph with ∆ > ∆ǫ, then χ2_ℓ(G) 6 3∆(1 + ǫ)/2.

artifact.category_tag: Graph coloring / square of planar graphs
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is fully resolved only for Δ(G) = 3 (Thomassen; Hartke–Jahanbekam–Thomas), giving χ(G²) ≤ 7. For Δ(G) ≥ 4 it remains open in general, though an asymptotic version is known: for every ε > 0, χ(G²) ≤ (3/2 + ε)Δ for Δ large enough (Havet–van den Heuvel–McDiarmid–Reed), even in the list-coloring setting. Various improved bounds and relaxations (e.g., for Δ = 4) have been obtained, but the exact Wegner bounds for Δ ≥ 4 are not established.

status_evidence.title: Relaxation of Wegner's Planar Graph Conjecture for maximum degree 4
status_evidence.snippet: Wegner conjectured that for Δ=4 the square is 9-colorable; this case remains open and a relaxed bound is proved.
status_evidence.claim: The Δ=4 case of Wegner's conjecture is still open.

status_evidence.title: The chromatic number of the square of subcubic planar graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Confirms Wegner's conjecture for subcubic planar graphs: χ(G²) ≤ 7.
status_evidence.claim: The Δ=3 case of the conjecture is resolved.

status_evidence.title: A bound on the chromatic number of the square of a planar graph
status_evidence.snippet: Provides an asymptotic bound of (3/2 + o(1))Δ for χ(G²) of planar graphs.
